turns.question: Which campaign had the highest total ad spend between 17 August and 2 October 2026, and how much did it spend in EUR?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on had the highest ad spend between 17 August and 2 October 2026, at 5,795 EUR (ad spend in EUR, summed over 17 August to 2 October 2026). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
